body.objective: Students will be able to name family members.
successCriteria: I can name family members in Mandarin
I can distinguish older and younger siblings
I can tell paternal and maternal grandparents apart
body.hook: English has one word for "brother," but Mandarin has two: 哥哥 for an older brother and 弟弟 for a younger one. Family words in Mandarin show age and which side of the family someone is on.

vocabulary.term: 爷爷 / 奶奶 yéye / nǎinai

study.title: 我的家
study.question: Who is in a family in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Family words (written for this lesson):
爸爸 bàba (dad), 妈妈 māma (mom).
Siblings: 哥哥 gēge (older brother), 姐姐 jiějie (older sister), 弟弟 dìdi (younger brother), 妹妹 mèimei (younger sister).
Grandparents: father's side: 爷爷 yéye (grandfather), 奶奶 nǎinai (grandmother); mother's side: 外公 wàigōng (grandfather), 外婆 wàipó (grandmother). (Some regions say 姥爷 lǎoye and 姥姥 lǎolao.)
Possession with 的: 我的妈妈 (my mom). With close family, 的 is often dropped: 我妈妈.
Text: 这是我的家。这是我爸爸, 这是我妈妈。这是我哥哥, 他十五岁。这是我妹妹, 她八岁。这是我奶奶。 Zhè shì wǒ de jiā. Zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma. Zhè shì wǒ gēge, tā shíwǔ suì. Zhè shì wǒ mèimei, tā bā suì. Zhè shì wǒ nǎinai.
这是 zhè shì = this is. 他 tā = he, 她 tā = she (same sound!).
Activity: draw a family tree (real or invented) and label it in characters and pinyin; introduce it with 这是我….
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Label and present a family tree
discussion: Why does Mandarin have two words for brother?
How are paternal and maternal grandparents different?
How do 他 and 她 differ?
study.product: Draw and label a family tree in characters and pinyin with at least six members, and present it with 这是我….

practice.q: How old is the brother in the text?
Why does Mandarin distinguish older and younger siblings?
practice.a: Age and family position are important in Chinese culture.

practice.q: Why is 的 often dropped with family?
How can you tell 他 from 她 in speech?
practice.a: You can't; only context or writing shows it.

misconceptions: Using 哥哥 for any brother
Thinking 他 and 她 sound different

items.answer: 哥哥, 姐姐, 弟弟, 妹妹.
爷爷, 奶奶, 外公, 外婆.
Different words for older and younger.

items.q: Explain why family terms show age and side.
items.answer: Family position matters in Chinese culture.

body.objective: Students will be able to use 有 and 个.
body.iCan: I can use 有 and 个.
successCriteria: I can use 有 and 没有 to say what I have
I can use the measure words 个 and 口
I can ask and answer how many people are in a family
body.hook: "How many people are in your family?" In Mandarin you'd say 你家有几口人? using 口, "mouth," as a counter for family members, as if counting mouths around the dinner table.

study.title: 你家有几口人?
study.question: How do I count people and things in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Grammar (written for this lesson):
有 yǒu = to have: 我有一个哥哥。(I have an older brother.) Negative: 没有 méiyǒu (never 不有): 我没有妹妹。
Measure words: in Mandarin, numbers need a measure word before nouns: number + measure word + noun. 个 gè is the most common: 一个哥哥, 三个朋友. Family size uses 口 kǒu: 我家有五口人。Animals often use 只 zhī: 两只猫, 一只狗.
两 liǎng (two) is used with measure words: 两个姐姐.
Questions: 你家有几口人? (How many people in your family?) 你有兄弟姐妹吗? Nǐ yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma? (Do you have siblings?)
和 hé joins nouns: 爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我.
Text: 我家有四口人: 爸爸、妈妈、弟弟和我。我没有哥哥, 也没有姐姐。我们有一只狗。
Activity: class survey: ask five classmates 你家有几口人? 你有兄弟姐妹吗? and record answers in characters.
study.source: Original text written for this lesson.
steps: Learn measure words 个, 口 and 只
discussion: Why is it 没有, not 不有?
Why does family size use 口?
When do you use 两 instead of 二?
What's the most common family size in class?
study.product: Write five sentences about your family using 有, 没有, 个, 口 and 只, and report one classmate's survey answers.

examples.title: Family size
examples.problem: "There are five people in my family."

practice.q: Say "I don't have a younger sister."
Ask "How many people are in your family?"
Say "There are four people in my family."
Why do numbers need measure words?
practice.a: Mandarin grammar requires them between numbers and nouns.

practice.q: Why is 口 used for family members?
Translate: I don't have older brothers or older sisters.
practice.a: 我没有哥哥, 也没有姐姐。

misconceptions: Saying 二个 instead of 两个

test.title: Practice test: Use 有 and 个

items.q: What do 有 and 没有 mean?
Say how many people are in your family.
Say what siblings you have or don't have.
Explain why Mandarin uses measure words.

body.objective: Students will be able to describe my family.
successCriteria: I can describe family members' age, job and personality
I can use 很 with adjectives
I can present my family in Mandarin
body.hook: Now you can introduce your whole family in Mandarin: who they are, how old they are, what they do and what they like. Today you'll put it all together in a short presentation.

study.title: 介绍我的家
study.question: How do I describe my family in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Model (written for this lesson):
大家好! 我叫 Mia。我家有五口人。我爸爸是医生, 他很高。我妈妈是老师, 她很好。我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。我哥哥十六岁, 他是学生, 他喜欢打篮球。我妹妹六岁, 她很可爱。我爱我的家!
Pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo! Wǒ jiào Mia. Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén. Wǒ bàba shì yīshēng, tā hěn gāo. Wǒ māma shì lǎoshī, tā hěn hǎo. Wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge hé yí ge mèimei. Wǒ gēge shíliù suì, tā shì xuésheng, tā xǐhuan dǎ lánqiú. Wǒ mèimei liù suì, tā hěn kě'ài. Wǒ ài wǒ de jiā!
Grammar: 很 + adjective: in Mandarin, adjectives usually need 很 (not 是): 他很高 (he is tall). Without 很, it can sound like a comparison.
Jobs with 是: 她是老师。
Useful adjectives: 高 tall, 矮 ǎi short, 好 good/kind, 可爱 kě'ài cute, 聪明 cōngming smart, 忙 máng busy.
Activity: present a real, invented or famous family for 1 minute with a picture or tree; classmates ask 他几岁? 她做什么工作? (What job does she do?)
study.source: Original model written for this lesson.
discussion: Why is it 他很高 and not 他是高?
How do you ask what job someone does?
study.product: Present a family of at least four people in Mandarin for 1 minute, including ages, jobs, adjectives with 很 and likes, and answer one question.

practice.q: Why is it 他很高, not 他是高?
practice.a: Adjectives don't use 是; they use 很.

practice.q: Translate: My grandfather is very smart and likes tea.
practice.a: 我爷爷很聪明, 他喜欢茶。

practice.q: What does 我爱我的家 mean?

misconceptions: Forgetting measure words when counting siblings

options: D) 她喜欢什么工作吗?

items.answer: 高, 好, 可爱, 聪明.

items.q: Describe a family member with 很.
Say what a family member likes.
Ask a classmate about a family member's age.
Explain 很 vs 是 with adjectives.
items.answer: Adjectives use 很, not 是.
